verdict.rationale: Tavily publishes a dedicated rate-limits page listing per-environment RPM (Development 100, Production 1,000) and documents 429 responses with a retry-after header. Its pricing page shows a no-credit-card free tier (1,000 credits/month) and pay-as-you-go billing, which implies a self-serve upgrade path, and usage endpoints let developers track consumption. Missing for 10: explicit concurrency caps (distinct from RPM), a documented step-by-step self-serve upgrade flow or per-plan limit table, and independent corroboration.
